metadata.title: Master Competitor Catalog Database: Wonderbly & Hooray Heroes

wonderbly_catalog.title: Bedtime For You
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Gentle, lyrical bedtime tale leading the child through the Land of Nod, closing the eyelids of nocturnal animals along the way.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Child name, avatar appearance (skin tone, hair color), custom dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: When You Were Born
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Poetic celebration of the child's entry into the world, integrating birth date, astrological constellations, and seasonal magic.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Child name, birth date, time of birth, birth city, avatar, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: Welcome to the World
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Gentle animals welcome the brand new baby to planet earth, offering blessings and wishes of bravery, wonder, and joy.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Child name, skin tone, birth date, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: The Little Boy / Girl Who Lost Their Name
wonderbly_catalog.premise: The global #1 bestseller. Child wakes up with their name missing from the bedroom door and travels across a fantasy landscape meeting animals that spell their name.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Name letters dynamically construct entire narrative sequence, 6 avatar presets, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: I'm a Name-O-Saurus
wonderbly_catalog.premise: The child's name is transformed into their very own dinosaur species roaring across prehistoric volcanic plains.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Child name transformed to Latin dinosaur genus, avatar, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: Your Treasury of Nursery Rhymes
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Classic nursery rhymes (Humpty Dumpty, Twinkle Twinkle, Hey Diddle Diddle) reimagined with the child illustrated directly into every nursery rhyme.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Child name, avatar embedded across 15 classic rhyme scenes, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: Where Are You? (Volume 1)
wonderbly_catalog.premise: High-energy Where's Waldo-style multiverse search book. The child travels across 6 alternate universes and must spot themselves in ultra-dense panoramic crowds.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Child avatar (9 skin tones, 12 hairstyles, glasses), surname, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: Where Are You? The Journey Through Time (Volume 2)
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Sequel to Where Are You. The child is lost across historical eras (Ancient Egypt, Wild West, Jurassic, Roaring Twenties) searching for themselves.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Child avatar, historical disguises, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: The Fantastic Road Trip
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Siblings pack their bags for an enchanted cross-country road trip over biscuit bridges, cloud mountains, and bubblegum rivers.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Up to 3 sibling avatars and names, chosen route, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: You Can Do Great Things
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Inspiring growth-mindset book teaching emotional resilience, self-worth, and perseverance through life's hurdles.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Child name, avatar, customized strength affirmations, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: I Love You This Much
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Shows how big a parent/grandparent's love is by comparing it to oceans, redwoods, and galaxies. Supports up to 4 siblings.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: 1 to 4 child names and avatars, adult gifter name ('Mummy', 'Daddy', 'Granny'), dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: That's My Cake!
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Hilarious, chaotic sibling rivalry story where brothers and sisters bicker over a delicious cake, eventually learning the joy of sharing.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: 2 to 4 sibling names and avatars, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: You're The Biggest
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Reassures the older child when a new baby arrives, showing them how important, capable, and loved they remain as the 'biggest'.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Big sibling name & avatar, baby name, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: You Are The Best Dad Ever
wonderbly_catalog.premise: The child selects 10 superhuman qualities describing why Dad is the absolute best (his bear hugs, his silly jokes, his bravery, his cooking).
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Dad's name & avatar, 1-4 kids names & avatars, selection of 10 custom qualities, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: You Are The Best Mom Ever
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Heartfelt tribute honoring Mom's daily heroism, infinite patience, and warm comfort, celebrating 10 qualities chosen by her kids.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Mom's name & avatar, 1-4 kids, 10 selected qualities, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: Oh, What Parents You’ll Be!
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Humorous, heartwarming survival guide celebrating new parenthood. Explicitly badged 'Illustrated by award-winning creatives – without AI'.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Both parents' names and avatars, baby's expected arrival, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: Your Life in Newspaper Headlines
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Luxury bound edition containing real, historical front pages from top national newspapers starting from the day the recipient was born to the present.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Recipient name embossed in gold foil on cover, birth date, newspaper choice, dedication page

wonderbly_catalog.title: The Book of Everyone
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Curated infographic celebration of an adult's life: number of heartbeats, songs #1 when born, events on their birthday, personal milestones.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Full name, birth date, uploaded photo, personal memories, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: The Christmas Wish
wonderbly_catalog.premise: On Christmas Eve, the child embarks on an enchanting journey to the North Pole to help Santa fix the magical wish machine.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: 1-4 child names and avatars, hometown location on Santa's map, dedication

wonderbly_catalog.title: The 12 Days of Christmas for [Name]
wonderbly_catalog.premise: Playful, festive adaptation of the classic 12 Days of Christmas carol, where the child is gifted funny and magical presents on every spread.
wonderbly_catalog.personalization_depth: Child name, avatar, dedication

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: You'll Always Be My Little Boy / Girl (Dad Edition)
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: The global viral sensation. Dad imagines all the everyday moments of his child growing up, realizing that no matter how big they become, they will always be his little child.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Detailed avatar (20 hairstyles, 8 beards, glasses, skin tone), 10 chosen stories out of 30, free photo upload, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Core driver of the famous 'Crying Dads' campaign (millions of views on TikTok)

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: When [Name] Grows Up (Daddy Edition)
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: Dad imagines the exciting professions his child could grow up to be (astronaut, veterinarian, soccer player, chef, musician, president) while promising eternal support.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Dad avatar, child avatar, select 10 careers out of 25 options, drag-and-drop order, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Top Father's Day bestseller

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: 10 Reasons Why I Love Daddy
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: A sweet, lighthearted list of 10 reasons why Dad is the best: fixing toys, giving piggyback rides, funny dancing, and bedtime cuddles.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Avatars, 10 selected reason stanzas, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Budget-friendly gifting entry point

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: Dad, I Wrote a Book About You
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: A funny and nostalgic review of Dad's most iconic habits, dad jokes, barbecue skills, and life wisdom from the perspective of an older child.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Adult child avatar, Dad avatar with grey beard options, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Father's Day gift for adult kids

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: You'll Always Be My Little Boy / Girl (Mom Edition)
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: The emotional counterpart to the Dad bestseller. Mom reminisces about first footsteps, nursery rhymes, and comfort hugs as her child grows.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Mom avatar, child avatar(s), 10 chosen stories, photo upload, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Mother's Day #1 bestseller

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: When [Name] Grows Up (Mommy Edition)
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: Mom dreams of her child's future triumphs, promising her steady hand and heart will guide them through every stage of life.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Mom avatar, child avatar, 10 selected career scenarios, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Mother's Day companion bestseller

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: 10 Reasons Why I Love Mommy
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: A playful collection of 10 reasons Mom makes the world warmer, safer, and funnier every single day.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Mom avatar, child avatar, 10 chosen reasons, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: High conversion for impulse gift buyers

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: Baby's Guide for Mommy and Daddy
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: A hilarious survival manual written from the baby's point of view, instructing Mom and Dad on diaper etiquette, midnight feeding demands, and baby mood swings.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Mom avatar, Dad avatar, Baby avatar, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Top baby shower gift

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: Grandma's Little Heroes
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: Celebrates the special, sweet bond between Grandma and her grandchildren, baking treats, sharing secret stories, and unconditional pampering.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Grandma avatar with silver hair options, up to 5 custom grandkid avatars, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: National Grandparents Day bestseller

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: Grandpa's Little Heroes
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: Grandpa shows his grandkids how to build birdhouses, fish at dawn, tell tall tales, and be curious adventurers.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Grandpa avatar with glasses & beard, up to 5 grandkid avatars, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Emotional Christmas gift for older dads/grandpas

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: 10 Reasons I Love You (Couples Edition)
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: A romantic tribute celebrating the unique, intimate bond between partners through 10 personalized love moments.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Both adult avatars, selection of 10 romantic milestones, dedicated LGBTQ+ options, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Valentine's Day #1 driver

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: 15 Reasons I Love You / Perfect Imperfections
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: Candid, charming celebration of genuine relationships: honoring both deep romantic chemistry and funny everyday quirks (bad driving, messy closets, movie debates).
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: 2 adult avatars, 15 selected relationship quirks, custom dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Highest AOV product on Hooray Heroes ($69.99)

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: The Dream Team (Sibling Adventure)
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: Brothers and sisters combine their talents to embark on an epic cooperative adventure through enchanted realms, discovering that family is the ultimate superpower.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: 2 to 5 distinct child avatars, names, custom group dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Solves gifting for families with multiple children

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: Hooray, [Name]! You Did It! (Potty Training)
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: Gentle, encouraging story empowering toddlers through the challenges and triumphant victory of ditching diapers for big-kid pants.
binding_options: Sturdy Toddler Hardcover with Tear-Resistant Pages
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Toddler avatar, diaper to potty milestone choices, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Practical parenting tool bought by mothers

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: Hooray, [Name]! Off to School We Go!
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: Calms first-day-of-school anxiety by showcasing meeting teachers, making new friends, circle time, and the joy of coming home to share accomplishments.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Child avatar, backpack color choice, school name, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Back-to-School seasonal surge product (August/September)

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: Happy Birthday, [Name]!
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: Magical woodland creatures prepare a grand surprise party tailored to the child's exact age, celebrating all their favorite things.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Child avatar, age number displayed prominently across story and cake, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Year-round evergreen birthday gift

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: The Pawsome Adventures of [Name] and [Dog/Cat]
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: Child and their furry best friend zoom across outer space, dive into sunken pirate treasure, and save the day together.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Child avatar, pet builder (60+ dog breeds, 25+ cat breeds, ear shapes, coat patterns, collar colors), dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Massive crossover appeal between pet lovers and parents

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: Forever the Goodest Pup (Dog Memorial Tribute)
hooray_heroes_catalog.target_audience: Pet Owners Mourning a Lost Dog
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: A gentle, comforting tribute honoring a deceased pet's joyful memory across the Rainbow Bridge, celebrating everlasting loyalty and love.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Detailed dog builder, owner avatars, dedication with memorial dates
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Deep emotional resonance with pet-owner bereavement

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: I Love You, [Dog's Name] (Dog Mom / Dog Dad Edition)
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: Celebrates the funny, chaotic, and unconditional bond between an adult and their dogs (muddy paws, stolen food, unconditional loyalty).
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: Adult avatar, 1 or 2 dog avatars, 10 selected funny pet quirks, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Huge hit with millennial and Gen Z pet parents

hooray_heroes_catalog.title: Merry Christmas, Little Heroes!
hooray_heroes_catalog.premise: The children team up with Santa and his reindeer to save Christmas morning, discovering the greatest gift of all is each other.
hooray_heroes_catalog.personalization_depth: 1-3 child avatars, festive pajama choices, dedication
hooray_heroes_catalog.viral_factor: Q4 holiday cash machine
